items.title: Deebo Samuel: Eyes Week 9 return
items.text:
Samuel (hamstring) has a chance to return following the 49ers' Week 8 bye, Matt Maiocco of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Mike Evans: Expected back after bye week
items.text:
Evans (Achilles) is expected to return after San Francisco's Week 8 bye, David Lombardi of SF Standard reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Christian McCaffrey: Dealing with mild hamstring strain
items.text:
McCaffrey is dealing with a mild hamstring strain rather than a quadriceps injury, and the 49ers believe he'll be ready following the team's Week 8 bye, David Lombardi of SF Standard reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Matthew Golden: Listed as DNP on Monday
items.text:

items.title: Jeremiyah Love: Set to practice Wednesday
items.text:
Head coach Mike LaFleur said Monday that Love (ankle) will take part in Wednesday's practice, Theo Mackie of The Arizona Republic reports.

items.title: Jalen Coker: Listed as limited Monday
items.text:
